annotations.title: Hand the setup to the owner

description: Says you are done filling the setup. The owner checks every part in Marsell, connects their social accounts and presses Start Marsell themselves; never confirm or start it for them. Then Marsell files it all where its own read would, reads the pictures, finds the communities and plans the first week. A business's first setup, started by someone who may publish and write to people for it, also lets Marsell go ahead on its own within the owner's limits (its own posts go without a card, each undoable until it goes, while pages and films follow the owner's spending choices, and it tells the owner each morning what went out); tell the owner, who can change it under Settings › Who Marsell talks to for you. It refuses until the owner's answers to get_setup's preferences questions are recorded (set_preferences), with who Marsell talks to for them (answer_first, find_and_email and ai_hands, each that is asked) and, unless homework is off, the pulling schedule they confirmed for you (set_preferences homework_schedule).
